name: agents-md-auditor
description: Audit AGENTS.md instruction files against the repository they describe, then revise them only after explicit approval.

interface.shortDescription: Find stale paths, scripts, and targets in AGENTS.md.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic, offline audit of every AGENTS.md and AGENTS.override.md in a repository. It checks documented paths, links, npm/pnpm/yarn/bun scripts, and make targets against the files that actually exist, flags package-manager mismatches, oversize instruction chains, overrides that shadow AGENTS.md, repeated or vague instructions, and credential-shaped values. Auditing never writes; revisions are proposed as a diff and applied only to approved AGENTS files.
defaultPrompt: Use $audit-agents-md to audit the AGENTS.md files in this repository and explain each finding. Do not edit files yet.
Use $revise-agents-md to propose fixes for the approved audit findings as a diff, and apply them only after I approve.
